Kingfisher Test Equipment Australian-designed and made Field ready, smart & accurate Reliable, rugged & accurate Long calibration cycle Sticklers® Microcare Cleaning Products Industry-leading performance Broad product range Excellent, cost-effective cleaning Travel safe and hazard free Explore the range CoreLink Plus Enclosure Range Australian-designed & assembled Unique cable management Rugged, durable & effective Flexible modular design Learn more Fibre Optic Manufacturers & Suppliers Fibre Optic Systems (FOS) is a fibre optic manufacturer, distributor and solutions provider headquartered in Knoxfield, Melbourne. FOS has operated for 25 years and holds a passion and commitment to bring the latest technology to the industry. Initially founded out of a desire to provide high volume, efficient and economical local production of all fibre optic assemblies, FOS has since grown to become an industry leading solutions provider.
